A.name: absent from all surveyed pages
established: No Yelp entry was visible in every catalog page explicitly surveyed.
supported: Yelp was not exposed by the surveyed catalog views at the observation time.
incompatible: a simultaneously visible enabled Yelp tile
remaining: installed record and exact binary remain unknown
the individual native filter result remains unknown
A.next_static: Compare recovered Yelp descriptor defaults with each catalog predicate and known AppManager persistence fields.
A.next_observation: Photograph the complete Apps/Favorites/Running page sequence once, without changing settings.

B.name: present but disabled
established: A Yelp entry was rendered but was not enabled for ordinary selection.
supported: identity and catalog rendering crossed more gates than an absent entry.
incompatible: normal selection from the same rendered state
remaining: the component that disabled the tile remains unknown
B.next_static: Trace the HMI Applet enabled/status fields populated from getAppList for a disabled rendering.
B.next_observation: Record the exact disabled styling and any adjacent status text without repeated taps.

C.name: launches and immediately exits
established: The enabled Yelp entry accepted a launch action and then left the visible Yelp flow.
supported: catalog exposure and at least part of the start/resume path ran.
compatible: native/AMS start failure after UI dispatch
incompatible: a persistent Yelp home screen in the same attempt
remaining: fresh start versus resume remains unknown
C.next_static: Correlate the observed timing with recovered notifyDestroyed and native start-failure paths.
C.next_observation: Record whether a Yelp splash appears and the elapsed time before the prior screen returns.

D.name: error displayed
established: Yelp displayed the recorded error text after the recorded ordinary action.
supported: the UI reached the error-handling path associated with any matched packaged signature.
not_established: network traffic unless the exact preceding action requires it
root cause of a generic error
incompatible: successful results for the same action and attempt
remaining: generic errors do not isolate the failed layer
D.next_static: Use the exact text match to inspect only its resource caller and status branch.
D.next_observation: Record the full error text, title, preceding action, and whether Yelp remains visible; do not retry solely for analysis.

E.name: registration or subscription screen
established: A screen presented registration, account, or subscription language in the Yelp launch flow.
supported: a post-launch account/service gate is active in the observed production state.
incompatible: claim that recovered Yelp has no runtime account dependency
remaining: no Yelp registration UI class is established statically
screen ownership and trigger remain unknown
E.next_static: Match the exact screen text against Yelp, common GUI, Register, Store, and native popup resources.
E.next_observation: Record the exact title/body/buttons and stop without accepting registration or changing account state.

F.name: normal home or search screen
established: Yelp remained visible at its ordinary home/search UI.
supported: catalog, start/resume, foreground, and sufficient UI initialization succeeded.
compatible: working local UI with untested network
incompatible: complete failure before any Yelp UI
F.next_static: Confirm which home controls enqueue GpSearchRequest and which require platform location or VR services.
F.next_observation: Record the first stable screen and whether controls are enabled; do not add a search solely for this framework.

G.name: fully functional ordinary flow
established: The observer explicitly reported a normal Yelp UI and relevant results from an ordinary search in the same documented flow.
supported: request construction, platform connectivity, TLS/HTTP response, parsing, and results display crossed their runtime gates.
compatible: usable stock-signed outbound Yelp client capability
incompatible: no response-dependent behavior occurred in the documented flow
remaining: speech remains unobserved unless separately recorded
arbitrary external input is not established
G.next_static: Compare the observed result fields with the recovered GpSearchRequest response schema.
G.next_observation: Preserve the existing observation record; no repeat action is needed solely for analysis.

H.name: unexpected, partial, or unmatched state
established: The supplied fields do not satisfy a more specific A-G outcome.
supported: a narrower observation record is needed before mapping a gate.
remaining: the first unresolved observable boundary remains unknown
H.next_static: Check whether the recorded text or styling matches any recovered resource before widening research.
H.next_observation: Record one complete stable screen, its title/text, and the page or preceding ordinary action.
